title: 第16章 比试第17章 法术比试
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
凌宇在完善功法后，不断熟悉新功法，还演练了各种法术。
而张浩自从青石镇回来后，也一直在闭关修炼。
得益于丹药的辅助，他在这段时间取得了很大的进步，炼气达到了灵觉境圆满，炼体也到了开窍境后期。
张浩想到自己的炼气已经圆满，感觉自己又行了。
毕竟以前和凌宇比试时，他从未赢过。这次自己进步如此之大，肯定能赢回来。
以前凌宇能赢，肯定是仗着境界高，绝对不是自己打不过他。
现在自己也到了灵觉圆满境，炼体也突破到了开窍境后期，而且第二境没那么快突破。
于是，他想回去找凌宇，找回场子。
走着走着，他就来到了凌宇家的练功场，看到凌宇正在练功。
这几天，凌宇一直在练功室完善功法，好久都没有活动了。
今天刚好可以活动一下，就看到张浩走了过来。
凌宇看着张浩，笑着说道：“浩子，好久不见，我可想死你了。”
他心里正想找个人试试自己的功法，这不，送上门的沙包就来了。
张浩看着凌宇格外亲切的笑容，心里直发毛，总觉得情况不对劲。
但他又想到自己已经是灵觉境圆满了，有什么好怕的。
于是他说道：“我也是啊，这不，一出关就来找你了，你还没有突破入道境吧？”
“还没呢。”
“那就好。”张浩小声嘀咕。
“你说什么？”由于声音太小，凌宇没有听清。
“没什么，没什么。”张浩连忙摆手，随后又为自己的胆怯感到羞耻。

他想，自己现在也是灵觉境圆满了，有什么好怕的？
于是，他又给自己鼓了鼓勇气，对凌宇说：“我看你一个人练得无聊，我来给你搭把手吧。”
“哟，今天太阳是从西边出来了吧？你以前可不是这么说的，你这是突破了？”凌宇疑惑。
“嘿嘿，小有突破，小有突破。”张浩挺了挺胸膛。
“行，那就练练。”凌宇无所谓地说。
“怎么比？你拿个主意吧！”
凌宇想了一下，说：“那就比试两场吧。第一场比拳脚和武器，第二场比术法，怎么样？”
“好，就这样，还是你会玩。”张浩开心地应道。
随即，两人走到武器架前，各自挑选了自己想用的武器。
凌宇取了一把剑，张浩拿了一把刀。
凌宇和张浩站在练功场的中央，他们的眼神中都充满了战意。
“准备好了吗？”凌宇问道。
“随时奉陪！”张浩回应。
清晨的阳光洒在空旷的广场上，也洒在凌宇和张浩身上，两人眼神中都闪烁着坚定的光芒。
张浩暗自想：“凌宇的实力深不可测，我必须小心应对，寻找他的破绽。”
他深吸一口气，率先出手，使出“狂狮拳法”，拳风呼啸，如雄狮怒吼，向凌宇扑去。
凌宇面带微笑，轻松地侧身躲开张浩的攻击，仿佛早已知晓他的出招路径。
content_en:
After Ling Yu perfected the exercises, he continued to become familiar with new ones and practiced various spells.
And Zhang Hao has been practicing in seclusion since he came back from Qingshi Town.
Thanks to the assistance of the elixir, he has made great progress during this period. His energy refining has reached the perfection of the spiritual awareness state, and his body refining has also reached the late stage of the enlightenment state.
Zhang Hao thought that his Qi refining had been completed and felt that he was good again.
After all, he had never won against Ling Yu before. I have improved so much this time, I will definitely win back.
In the past, Ling Yu could win because of his high level. It was definitely not because he couldn't beat him.
Now I have reached the realm of spiritual enlightenment perfection, and my body refining has also broken through to the late stage of the awakening realm, and the second realm is not broken through so quickly.
So, he wanted to go back to Ling Yu and regain his place.
While walking, he came to Ling Yu's practice ground and saw Ling Yu practicing.
In the past few days, Ling Yu has been perfecting his skills in the practice room and has not been active for a long time.
I was just able to move around a bit today when I saw Zhang Hao walking over.
Ling Yu looked at Zhang Hao and said with a smile: "Haozi, long time no see, I miss you so much."
He was just thinking about finding someone to try his skills, but here came the sandbags delivered to his door.
Zhang Hao looked at Ling Yu's extraordinarily friendly smile, and his heart went crazy. He always felt that something was wrong.
But he also thought that he had already reached the perfection of spiritual awareness, so there was nothing to be afraid of.
So he said: "Me too, no, I will come to you as soon as I leave seclusion. You haven't broken through to the Taoist realm yet, right?"
"Not yet."
"That's good." Zhang Hao whispered.
"What did you say?" Ling Yu didn't hear clearly because his voice was too low.
"Nothing, nothing." Zhang Hao waved his hands quickly, and then felt ashamed of his timidity.
He thought, now that he has reached the realm of spiritual enlightenment, what is there to be afraid of?
So, he encouraged himself again and said to Ling Yu: "I think you are bored practicing alone, so let me help you."
"Hey, the sun came out from the west today, right? You didn't say that before. Did you make a breakthrough?" Ling Yu was confused.
"Hehe, a small breakthrough, a small breakthrough." Zhang Hao puffed out his chest.
"Okay, let's practice." Ling Yu said nonchalantly.
"How to compare? Come up with an idea!"
Ling Yu thought for a while and said: "Then let's have two competitions. The first one is a fist and weapon competition, and the second one is a magic competition. How about that?"
"Okay, that's it, you still know how to play." Zhang Hao responded happily.
Immediately, the two walked to the weapon rack and each selected the weapon they wanted to use.
Ling Yu took a sword, and Zhang Hao took a knife.
Ling Yu and Zhang Hao stood in the center of the training ground, their eyes full of fighting spirit.
"Are you ready?" Ling Yu asked.
"I'll be with you anytime!" Zhang Hao responded.
The early morning sunshine shone on the empty square and also on Ling Yu and Zhang Hao. Both of them had a firm light in their eyes.
Zhang Hao thought to himself: "Ling Yu's strength is unfathomable. I must deal with him carefully and find his flaws."
He took a deep breath and took the lead to take action, using the "Crazy Lion Fist". The wind roared like a roaring lion, and he rushed towards Ling Yu.
Ling Yu smiled and easily sidestepped Zhang Hao's attack, as if he already knew his path.
